content.user_title: Find Tiny House Plans and Downloadable Layouts
content.value_statement: Finding compact house layouts with useful comparison details can take time. This skill searches AI Architectures and presents plan images, specifications, and available downloads.
actual_capabilities: Search the AI Architectures library for tiny house plans up to 600 square feet.
Apply requested bedroom, story, and garage filters.
Present three to six matches with area, bedrooms, bathrooms, stories, floor plan images, and page links.
Retrieve available PDF, DXF, IFC, and GLB links for a selected plan.
Relax one filter at a time when no plan matches, while explaining each change.
Convert area requirements using the documented approximation of 10.76 square feet per square meter.
limitations: Searches require an available AI Architectures MCP connection and working remote tools.
The skill searches existing concepts; custom drawing depends on the separate floor-plan-cad skill.
Plans are not permit or construction documents and require local code checks and professional review.
Catalog availability, download access, and the stated free access depend on the external provider.

use_cases.title: Compare Compact Living Options
use_cases.description: Compare small home concepts by size, bedroom count, and floor plan before choosing layouts for further review.

use_cases.title: Collect Design References
use_cases.description: Find compact layouts and retrieve available CAD or model files for early design discussions.

use_cases.title: Study Small Home Layouts
use_cases.description: Review floor plan images and room sizes to compare space allocation across several small home concepts.

prompt_templates.title: Browse Tiny House Concepts
prompt_templates.prompt: Find three tiny house plans under 600 square feet. Show their floor plan images, sizes, bedrooms, bathrooms, stories, and page links.

prompt_templates.title: Filter a Shortlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to six tiny house plans under 500 square feet with one bedroom and one story. Compare their layouts and page links.

prompt_templates.title: Retrieve Selected Plan Files
prompt_templates.prompt: For the plan with slug [plan slug], retrieve its details and available PDF, DXF, IFC, and GLB download links.

prompt_templates.title: Handle Constraints and Missing Matches
prompt_templates.prompt: Find two-bedroom, single-story tiny house plans under 45 square meters. If none match, propose one filter change before retrying. Compare results and retrieve my selection.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine area conversion, filters, and staged selection.

output_examples.input: Search for one-bedroom, single-story tiny house plans under 45 square meters.
output: Search criteria: tiny house, one bedroom, one story, maximum approximately 484 square feet.
Each returned match includes its name, area, bedrooms, bathrooms, stories, floor plan image, and page link.
Plan names and specifications depend on live catalog results.

output_examples.input: Show download options for the plan I selected.
output: Selected plan: the catalog entry you chose.
Download links: PDF plan set, DXF, IFC, and GLB, where returned by the provider.
These are concept plans, not permit or construction documents.

best_practices: Approve and review the external MCP connection before setup, and avoid including private site details in search requests.
State your area limit and required bedrooms, stories, or garage features before searching.
Have a licensed professional review the selected concept against local codes before planning construction.
anti_patterns: Treating downloaded concept plans as approved construction or permit documents.
Assuming a missing layout exists or that every advertised download format is currently available.
Expecting custom drawings without the separate floor-plan-cad skill.

faq.question: Where does the skill search?
faq.answer: It searches the AI Architectures plan library through remote MCP tools.

faq.question: Does setup require an external connection?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions use an AI Architectures MCP server. Review the provider and approve registration before changing your client configuration.

faq.question: Are the plans free?
faq.answer: The source describes free access without an account. Current access and download conditions depend on the external provider.

faq.question: Which download formats can it retrieve?
faq.answer: The workflow requests PDF plan sets, DXF, IFC, and GLB links for the selected plan, subject to availability.

faq.question: Can I use metric area limits?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions use an approximate conversion of 10.76 square feet per square meter.

faq.question: Can I build directly from these plans?
faq.answer: No. They are concepts, not permit or construction documents. A licensed professional must assess local requirements and buildability.
